title: Restore load reliability and logged-out browsing resilience

requirements.summary: Ensure the published app reliably loads the main UI after redeploy (no blank screen / infinite loading).
acceptanceCriteria: The published app loads to the main UI without showing a blank screen or getting stuck on an infinite loading state.
No uncaught exceptions appear in the browser console during initial load.

file_operations.description: Align initial-load queries with the currently available backend interface (prefer public read methods for feeds/details) and avoid throwing during boot (e.g., skip getCallerUserProfile when logged out) so the app can render even when some queries fail. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add a top-level React error boundary that renders a readable fallback UI with a retry/reload action so unexpected runtime errors do not result in a blank screen.
Wrap the application root with the new AppErrorBoundary so any uncaught render-time errors show a stable fallback UI instead of a blank page.
Reduce/avoid blocking the full app on profile-loading state (especially when logged out) and ensure initial rendering proceeds with safe defaults even if profile queries are unavailable or errored.

requirements.summary: Render a resilient logged-out browsing state when authorization-gated backend reads fail, with a clear login call-to-action (including on /admin).
acceptanceCriteria: When the user is logged out, the Home/Forum/Second-hand pages render a usable read-only UI (or a login-gated UI) without crashing.
If a query returns an authorization error, the UI shows a non-technical message explaining login is required and provides a login button or directs the user to the existing login control.
Admin route (/admin) does not crash for logged-out users; it shows an access/login prompt rather than a blank screen.

file_operations.description: Create a reusable logged-out/unauthorized state component that displays a friendly message and a login CTA, using the selected "authorization" component patterns for login/logout behavior. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add consistent authorization-error detection/normalization for read queries (posts, listings, post details, replies, admin reads) and expose an easy-to-consume flag/message for the UI so pages can render a logged-out state instead of failing. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Handle authorization failures from the posts feed query by rendering a readable logged-out/read-only state and showing a clear login CTA (via LoggedOutStateCard) rather than only a loading/empty state. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Handle authorization failures from posts queries by rendering a login-gated/read-only UI with a clear login CTA (via LoggedOutStateCard) while keeping the page navigable and non-crashing. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Make listings browsing resilient when listing feed/favorites calls fail due to authorization: keep the public listings tab usable for logged-out users and render a clear login CTA for favorites/interactive actions using LoggedOutStateCard. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Prevent /admin from crashing or redirecting to a blank state when logged out or unauthorized by rendering an access/login prompt (LoggedOutStateCard) and gating admin data fetching until the user is authenticated and authorized. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Ensure navigation to /admin continues to render a stable UI for logged-out users (admin prompt state) instead of contributing to a blank screen through redirects or unhandled query errors.
